# Find fiber optics for the challenges

![Find fiber optics for the challenges](/uploads/357_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

In the daily or weekly challenges it is sometimes necessary to find scrap that can be recycled into fiber optics. There are some items you can collect for this. If you have problems finding the items, it's best to empty your loot list before collecting them, see: Respawning items and enemies, this is how it works. Loot lists explained.

## Scrap items that contain fiberglass optics

- Microscope
- Biometric scanners
- Bulk fiberglass look
- Flight recorder
- High performance microscope

If you're lucky, you'll find the large quantities e.g. at Whitespring Mall retailers. Microscopes can be found in schools, clinics and research institutions. You can find biometric scanners, for example in destroyed turrets.

## Places with fiberglass optics scrap

- AVR Medical Center (microscope)
- Arktor Pharma (microscope)
- Ella Ames Bunker (microscope)
- West Tek Research Center (microscope)
- Morgantown High School (microscope)
- Morgantown Airport (Microscope)
- Hut on hill southeast of Crater (black box)
